title: COLA RECONCILIATION · Evidence first
copy: Compare invoices on the left with the master statement on the right, keeping evidence in view.

title: Run the built-in sample
copy: This walkthrough uses the built-in sample animation and matching rules, not live AI or OCR.

title: Invoice ID & final payable amount
copy: Locate the invoice number and final payable amount, preserving the original extracted values.

title: Search every statement line
copy: Find candidates across all statement lines. Inspect a suggestion to highlight its source row.

title: Suggestions are not approvals
copy: Equal amounts may belong to different invoices. A possible O / 0 error still requires review.

title: Exception queues
copy: Triage amount differences, ID issues, multiple candidates, missing matches and shared lines.

title: Open the invoice review
copy: Open the relevant review directly from the queue. Keep extraction and human decisions separate.

title: Choose a candidate, then confirm
copy: Choose statement row 2 and inspect its location. Selecting a candidate does not change the ID.

title: A documented manual decision
copy: In this sample, correct the final O to 0 and document the decision. Keep the original extraction.

title: Preserve the original & review history
copy: Trace the original ID, manual correction and review history without silently replacing evidence.

title: Updated outcomes, visible remaining work
copy: Return to all results. Confirmed items remain distinct from those still requiring manager review.

title: COLA · Traceable reconciliation
copy: Locate evidence → inspect candidates → triage exceptions → review decisions → retain audit history.
